component.name: ChestZip
component.summary: Archive manager with zip bomb protection

description.p: ChestZip creates and extracts archives in its own open CHZ format as well as ZIP, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.BZ2 and TAR.XZ, and extracts RAR archives.
It is built to be safe: it detects zip bombs while extracting, blocks Zip Slip path traversal and malicious symbolic links, and never fills up your disk.

ul.li: CHZ format: solid LZMA2 compression, AES-256-GCM encryption with hidden file names
Browse inside archives, drag and drop, test integrity
Same interface on Linux, Windows and macOS, in English and Turkish

description.p: New: convert archives between formats (e.g. CHZ to ZIP, RAR to CHZ).
